16 The Woods, Glounthaune, Co. Cork (T45 P628)
Stunning 4-Bedroom Split-Level Semi-Detached Residence in Immaculate Condition

Dan Howard & Co Ltd Auctioneers are delighted to present this exceptional 4-bedroom split-level semi-detached home to the market. Presented in immaculate, walk-in condition throughout, this property offers a rare opportunity to secure a truly turn-key family home. From the outside, it presents with the deceptive charm of a bungalow — but step through the front door and it unfolds into a spacious, light-filled, three-storey home extending to an impressive 182m².
Ground Floor
Two well-proportioned bedrooms, one benefitting from a private ensuite — ideal for guests or multi-generational living.
Lower Ground Floor
A bright and welcoming sitting room, along with a separate kitchen/dining/living room — perfect for entertaining or relaxed family life. This level is completed by a practical utility room and guest WC.
First Floor
Two further bedrooms and a family bathroom, offering privacy and space away from the main living areas.
Outside
Parking to the front and a private garden to the rear.
Condition & Energy Efficiency
This home has been beautifully maintained and is presented in excellent decorative order from top to bottom, meaning there's nothing to do but move in and enjoy. Adding to its appeal is an outstanding A3 BER rating — a genuinely exceptional energy rating for a home of this size and age, and one you'll rarely come across on the market. This translates directly into low heating and running costs, excellent thermal comfort year-round, and real peace of mind for a buyer looking for an efficient, modern home rather than one requiring costly retrofitting.
Location
Glounthaune is one of Cork's most sought-after commuter villages, and it's easy to see why. Glounthaune railway station sits right on the Cork Commuter line, at the junction between the Cobh and Midleton branches, with the train into Cork city taking just 12 minutes — a genuinely easy commute for anyone working in the city centre. Bus routes also serve the area, giving excellent additional options for getting around. Investment in the line continues too, with works underway to double-track the Glounthaune to Midleton corridor as part of a wider upgrade designed to increase train frequency on the Cork commuter network — great news for future-proofing your commute.
The village itself has a lovely community feel, with local shops, pubs and restaurants close by, plus the added bonus of nearby Fota Island — home to Fota Wildlife Park and Fota House & Gardens — along with easy access to Cobh and Midleton.
For anyone working locally, the location is hard to beat. Little Island and Carrigtwohill — two of Cork's largest employment and business hubs — are just minutes away by car or train, home to major employers including Gilead Sciences, Stryker, and GE Healthcare, along with a wide range of other pharmaceutical, tech and business park employers. This makes 16 The Woods an outstanding option for professionals looking to cut their commute without compromising on a quiet, village setting to come home to.
